name: SIM Card Swap
summary: Adversaries may gain access to mobile devices through transfers or swaps from victims’ phone numbers to adversary-controlled SIM cards and mobile devices. The typical process is as follows: 1. Adversaries will first gather information about victims through Phishing, social engineering, data breaches, or other avenues. 2.
